At the beginning of your shift, you prepare for your assigned route. You check what you need for the day, get into the delivery van and use navigation to drive to your first customer. You provide friendly service and make sure the groceries are handed over carefully. If there are empty crates to return, you take these back with you. Once everything is taken care of, you continue to the next customer. Your working day is a combination of driving, physical activity and customer contact. At the same time, you have plenty of independence while completing your route through Eindhoven and the surrounding area. After your final delivery, you return to the location, complete your route and leave the van ready for the next shift. Do I need previous experience as a delivery driver?
